oracle.scope: Pinned CoreKit vectorkit/turboquant: math/rand rotation signs, Walsh-Hadamard, forward/inverse rotation, Encode/Decode/Score/ScoreCosine, 32-byte metadata, sidecar blob/JSON and error strings. Generator --check must pass on arm64 (Go fuses FMA) and amd64; encode bytes and scores are exact, decode is recorded on a scale/4096 grid because Go decode bits are architecture-dependent.
